_comment: Attack shapes we know the detector handles only partially. Tracked in every eval run (family 'convention_shaped' and anything listed here) but never used as a CI gate. Promote to a gate once recall is stable.

families.description: Supply-chain shaped 'conventions' in developer docs: pipe-to-shell, disabling review/CI/verification, installing from unknown sources, pointing tooling at new hosts. The classifier scores these as benign; only the supply-chain regex family fires, capped at FLAG.
Non-English direct injections. The ProtectAI DeBERTa model was trained mostly on English; regex rules are English-only. Recall is reported per language in the eval but not gated.
